* The callback interface is called by the Metrics data creator to receive information from
     * others controllers.

methods.name: public void onImsRegistrationFeatureTagStats(int subId, List<String> featureTagList, int registrationTech)
methods.comment:
* Notify the callback listener that the feature tag associated with
         * IMS registration of this device have changed.

methods.name: public void onStoreCompleteImsRegistrationFeatureTagStats(int subId)
methods.comment: * Notify that the active IMS registration to the carrier network has been terminated.

methods.name: void onImsRegistrationServiceDescStats(int subId, List<String> serviceIdList, List<String> serviceIdVersionList, int registrationTech)
methods.comment:
* Notify the callback listener that the PIDF ServiceDescriptions associated with
         * the UCE presence of this device have changed.

methods.name: void onSubscribeResponse(int subId, long taskId, int networkResponse)
methods.comment: * Notify the callback listener that a subscribe response received.

methods.name: void onUceEvent(int subId, int type, boolean successful, int commandCode, int networkResponse)
methods.comment: * Notify the callback listener that a UCE Network Event has occurred.

methods.name: void onSubscribeTerminated(int subId, long taskId, String reason)
methods.comment: * Notify the callback listener that a subscribe has ended.

methods.name: void onPresenceNotifyEvent(int subId, long taskId, List<RcsContactUceCapability> updatedCapList)
methods.comment: * Notify that the Presence Notify Event has changed.

methods.name: void onStoreCompleteImsRegistrationServiceDescStats(int subId)
methods.comment: * Notify that the active UCE PUBLISH to the carrier network has been terminated.
